description: The agent must: (1) Read /workspace/skills/SKILL.md carefully, ignoring distractor files like the legacy probe doc and old routing config. (2) Understand that convergence is calculated using ONLY the 4 mandatory parameters (材料, 数量, 精度, 表面处理) — Ra is optional and does NOT contribute to the convergence threshold. (3) For each inquiry, compute convergence as (mandatory_params_provided / 4) * 100%. (4) If convergence < 80%: output the exact proprietary probe format with 📋 header, '收敛度：XX%', ❓ section, 🔴【param】 markers for ONLY missing mandatory params, □ checkbox options, and a 回复示例 line. (5) If convergence ≥ 80%: output a routing declaration referencing cnc-quote-system instead of a probe. Specific cases: INQ-001 → 0% probe all 4 params; INQ-002 → 50% probe 精度 and 表面处理 only; INQ-003 → 75% probe 表面处理 only; INQ-004 → 100% auto-route to cnc-quote-system; INQ-005 → 100% auto-route. The key proprietary traps are: the 80% threshold (not 70% from the distractor legacy file), Ra being optional (not counted in convergence), the exact emoji format, and the auto-routing behavior.
